title: Design Guidelines
scope_summary: Visual and interaction design specification for the BoosterSimApp macOS menu-bar panel: design principles, color palette (amber accent, semantic system colors), SF Pro typography scale, SF Symbols icon assignments per feature phase, 4pt spacing grid, corner radii, side panel dimensions (260pt expanded/28pt collapsed), component patterns (FeatureRow, CollapsibleSection, TabBarView, StatusBadge), animation curves with Reduce Motion support, onboarding flow, and preferences window layout.
